two_captcha_api_key_note: On-demand CAPTCHA-solving key (2captcha.com). No code path consumes it automatically today; it is kept as an available tool for form/portal workflows that hit a CAPTCHA. Live key lives in the deployed copy and as TWOCAPTCHA_API_KEY in ~/.ea/.env.
form_url_note: The department's travel reimbursement form. An institution plugin may ship an adapter that files the trip packet on it (docs/ea/reimbursement.md); without one the EA prepares the packet and the user files it at this link.
